synopsis: The purpose of this notice of funding opportunity (NOFO) is to support pilot and feasibility studies to inform the design and conduct of efficacy, effectiveness, and/or services research trials. Topics may include: 1) developing interventions to prevent substance use, misuse, or progression to substance use disorder; 2) prevention, treatment, or recovery services research, including research addressing comorbid pain and medical and mental health disorders; and 3) HIV eradication research, including implementation science, prevention, treatment and recovery in substance use settings/populations.
title: Pilot and Feasibility Studies in Preparation for Substance Use and HIV Prevention Intervention and Services Research Trials (R34 Clinical Trial Optional)
